name: 纹理周期性分析
description: Detects periodic 文本ure patterns common in AI generation
algorithm: Texture Periodicity — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes texture periodicity for image forensic analysis, based on texture analysis frameworks from Haralick et al. (1973):

1. **Autocorrelation分析**: The 2D autocorrelation function of the image (or image regions) is computed. Periodic textures produce peaks in the autocorrelation at the period intervals. The method extracts periodicity parameters: period, orientation, and regularity.

2. **Power频谱Periodicity**: The 2D Fourier power spectrum is analyzed for spectral peaks indicating periodic content. The location of peaks reveals the spatial frequency and orientation of periodic patterns. The method distinguishes between natural periodicities (fabric weave, architectural patterns) and artificial periodicities (GAN grid artifacts, aliasing patterns).

3. **PeriodRegularity评估**: The regularity (or irregularity) of detected periodicities is measured. Natural periodic textures show slight irregularity (variation in period, phase jitter) from the physical process generating them. AI-generated periodicities may be either too regular (perfect repetition from learned patterns) or show characteristic period variation from the generation process.

4. **Periodicity空间分布**: The spatial distribution of periodic content is mapped. Natural periodic textures are confined to specific objects (fabric, brickwork). AI generation may produce subtle periodicities throughout the image from the convolutional architecture (grid artifacts appearing across all generated content).

5. **PeriodicityFeature评分**: Periodicity features (detected periods, regularity measures, spatial distribution, spectral peak analysis) are combined into a forensic score. The score captures the presence of anomalous periodicities characteristic of AI generation or manipulation.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： 文本ure periodicity 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Haralick, R.M. et al. (1973). Textural Features for Image Classification. IEEE TSMC.
Manjunath, B.S. & Ma, W.Y. (1996). Texture Features for Browsing and Retrieval of Image Data. IEEE TPAMI.
